name: vue-sentinel-x
description: Performance and health monitoring for Vue 3 apps — static component graphs, runtime lifecycle/memory/performance tracking, and an Intelligence Engine
author: Amir Maghami

scripts.build: bun run --filter '@vue-sentinel-x/core' build && bun run --filter '@vue-sentinel-x/runtime' build && bun run --filter '@vue-sentinel-x/vite-plugin' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/core build && bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/core typecheck && bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/runtime typecheck && bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/vite-plugin typecheck && bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/dashboard typecheck
scripts.release: bun run build && bun run publish:packages
scripts.publish:packages: bun run --filter '@vue-sentinel-x/core' publish && bun run --filter '@vue-sentinel-x/runtime' publish && bun run --filter '@vue-sentinel-x/vite-plugin' publish
